# `packslip install`

- **Usage:** `packslip install [FLAGS] <PROJECT>`

Install an authenticated upstream release and export its declared commands

Keeps the complete installation tree. Does not run downloaded code, install dependencies, or edit shell configuration. Use --system for a shared install.

## Arguments
- **`<PROJECT>`** — Project name (owner/repo, github.com/owner/repo[/subpath], or host[/path])

## Flags
- **`--version <VERSION>`** — Version, prefix, tag, or latest (the default)
- **`--system`** — Install for all users; Unix root uses this scope by default
- **`--user`** — Explicitly select the current user's installation scope
- **`--force`** — Replace conflicting command entries and unmarked installation directories
- **`--offline`** — Use only locally cached, authenticated metadata and artifacts
- **`--install-dir <INSTALL_DIR>`** — Override the installation tree without moving trust state
- **`--bin-dir <BIN_DIR>`** — Override the command directory without moving trust state
- **`--variant <VARIANT>`** — Select a publisher's named variant
- **`--pin <PIN>`** — Allowed signer fingerprint (repeatable, alternatives within this option)
- **`--pubkey <PUBKEY>`** — Ed25519 public key or path to its public-key file
- **`--issuer <ISSUER>`** — Require this OIDC issuer as well as the project's default identity
- **`--identity <IDENTITY>`** — Require this exact certificate identity
- **`--identity-prefix <IDENTITY_PREFIX>`** — Require this certificate identity prefix
- **`--accept-trust-change <ACCEPT_TRUST_CHANGE>`** — Approve one exact displayed trust-change proposal (repeatable)
- **`--trusted-root <TRUSTED_ROOT>`** — Administrator-supplied Sigstore trusted_root.json instead of TUF refresh
- **`--allow-unlogged`** — Accept signatures without transparency-log entries for this attempt
- **`--allow-incompatible-host`** — Accept the selected artifact's incompatible host requirements
- **`--max-extracted-size <MAX_EXTRACTED_SIZE>`** — Local maximum expanded archive size in bytes

  **Default:** `10737418240`
- **`--max-archive-entries <MAX_ARCHIVE_ENTRIES>`** — Local maximum archive entry count

  **Default:** `100000`
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
